_note: Scam-script cues shared by the backend (amaan/scoring/text_cues.py) and the apps (packages/core/src/cues.ts). Edit here, then copy to packages/core/src/data/cues.json (a test checks both copies are identical). Patterns are regexes; Arabic is normalized (أإآ->ا, ئؤ->ء, ة->ه, ى->ي) on both the pattern and the message.

cues.title: Asks you to share a code
cues.why: Banks, OMT, Whish and WhatsApp never ask you to send a verification code. Sharing it gives away your account.

cues.title: Prize, gift or lottery
cues.why: Unexpected prizes that need a fee, a code or your details are a classic scam.

cues.title: Asks for money or a transfer
cues.why: Requests to transfer money, pay a 'fee' or top up a number are the end goal of most scams.

cues.title: Pressure or threat
cues.why: Scams create urgency (account blocked, last chance) so you act before thinking.

cues.title: Promises or mentions a large amount of money
cues.why: Big sums of money out of nowhere are bait.

cues.title: Pushes you to click a link
cues.why: Messages that rush you to a link usually lead to a fake login or payment page.

cues.title: Parcel or delivery pretext
cues.why: Fake 'your parcel is waiting' messages lead to payment or login pages.

cues.title: Claims to be a bank, telecom or official body
cues.why: Scammers pose as banks, OMT/Whish, touch/alfa, or the government. Contact them on their official number.
